title: Most of your dbt models aren't in a hurry: How to stop paying for the whole DAG
description:
How Authentic Insurance cut Snowflake costs 40% by pairing dbt with Espresso AI's DAG-aware warehouse sizing. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Ben Lerner, CEO of Espresso AI, explains why most models in a dbt DAG are not on the critical path, so running them on smaller warehouses saves money without slowing the job. Warehouse sizing follows an Amdahl's Law pattern: each size step roughly doubles cost without doubling speed. Saravana Kumar, CTO of Authentic Insurance, shows the result in production: 40% savings every quarter, with dbt runs routed to right-sized warehouses automatically.

In this session you'll learn:
• Why downsizing compute off the critical path saves credits
• How Amdahl's Law explains diminishing returns from bigger warehouses
• How Authentic Insurance runs this in production

Speakers: Ben Lerner, CEO, Espresso AI; Saravana Kumar, CTO, Authentic Insurance

Learn more about dbt: https://www.getdbt.com/blog/dbt-summit-2026-product-announcements
